name: create_trigger
description: Create a Routine (scheduled trigger). Three targeting modes: (1) default — fires into THIS SESSION, resuming the same conversation each time; (2) persistent_session_id set — fires into a SPECIFIC OTHER SESSION you name (must be in your account); (3) create_new_session_on_fire=true — spawns a FRESH SESSION in this environment on each firing. Use mode 1 for recurring work you want to pick back up yourself; mode 2 for waking a sibling session you created; mode 3 when each firing should start from a clean slate.

prompt.description: The message the Routine sends on each firing. When binding to an existing session (modes 1-2), write it assuming past context. In fresh-session mode (mode 3), write it as a complete standalone instruction since each firing starts from nothing.

cron_expression.description: Standard 5-field cron expression. Minimum interval is hourly. Mutually exclusive with run_once_at. Omit both for a poke-only Routine that never fires on its own schedule.

run_once_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for a one-shot fire (e.g. 2026-04-20T17:00:00Z). Must be in the future. Mutually exclusive with cron_expression.

persistent_session_id.description: Optional session ID to fire into instead of this one. Must belong to the same account. Mutually exclusive with create_new_session_on_fire.

create_new_session_on_fire.description: If true, each firing creates a fresh session in the calling session's environment. Default false. Mutually exclusive with persistent_session_id.

environment_id.description: Environment ID (starts with 'env_'). Defaults to the calling session's environment.

notifications.description: Completion notifications. Only apply to fresh-session-per-fire Routines. Pass {} to opt out of all channels.
